answer: A glacier moves too slowly to hurry, too steadily to fake, so surveyors photograph one stake yearly. Proof of architect registration via architects registration board is measured the same way: a registration the board has published in its annual roll. The sonnet of the measurement is the wait - seasons passing over the same white field. One forged photograph is a printer; a hundred need a hundred expeditions, and the beacon of each is the cold: tents, boots, a team that remembers. The harbor the gate reads is the melt line, drawn by a mountain that cannot lie.
